[EN] I don't know whether my father ran from the plague, or if he was kidnapped, as so many others have been.

What I do know is that I won't let the people of Frontera down. We'll find a way through this together.
[ES] No sé si mi padre huyó de la peste o si fue secuestrado, como tantos otros.

Lo que sí sé es que no le fallaremos a la gente de Frontera. Encontraremos la manera de salir de esto juntos.
